brightness.docs:
**percentage**: Set display brightness in %. Only can be used with SSD1305. Defaults to `100%`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

contrast.docs:
**percentage**: Set display contrast in %. Defaults to `100%`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

external_vcc.docs:
**boolean**: Set this to true if you have the VCC pin connected to an external power supply. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

flip_x.docs:
**boolean**: Flip the horizontal axis on the screen. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

flip_y.docs:
**boolean**: Flip the vertical axis on the screen. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

invert.docs:
**boolean**: Invert all pixel state on the display. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

model.docs:
The model of the display. Options are:

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

offset_x.docs:
**int**: Set this option if some horizontal pixel is missing. Numbers are only allowed between `0~128`. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

offset_y.docs:
**int**: Set this option if some vertical pixel is missing. Numbers are only allowed between `0~128`. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The RESET pin. Defaults to not connected.

*See also: [SSD1306 OLED Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/ssd1306#configuration-variables)*
